observations: Photo 0: Black DSLR camera held in hand, front view, 'Canon' logo and 'EOS Rebel T6i' text visible on body, lens mounted marked 'CANON ZOOM LENS EF-S 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6 IS STM' with 58mm filter thread.
Photo 1: Top view showing mode dial (SCN, Av, Tv, P, M, Auto, Movie), ON/OFF switch, ISO and DISP buttons, hot shoe (no flash unit attached), zoom ring marked '55'.

Photo 2: Rear view, LCD screen closed/folded flat against body (screen content not visible, cannot confirm it powers on or display condition), viewfinder, MENU/INFO/Q/SET/AF/WB buttons, playback and trash buttons, strap attached.
No shots of: camera powered on, LCD screen lit, battery, charger, memory card, lens cap, box, or any accessories.
No visible major physical damage (no cracks, no missing buttons) but normal handling wear and some surface marks visible near hot shoe area in photo 1.
A small dark mark/spot is visible on the front lens glass element in photo 0, unclear if dust, smudge, or internal defect.

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown; high count lowers value significantly for this entry-level body
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot

Photo of LCD screen opened and displaying an image or menu
Photo showing shutter count via menu or firmware info
Close-up photo of lens front and rear glass elements in good light
Photo of all included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, strap, box
response.reason: Brand and model are clearly identifiable from the photos, but no functional proof (power-on, screen, shutter count, lens clarity) or accessories are shown, so the item must be priced at worst case as an untested body+lens only with an unresolved lens-glass concern.
